description.zh: 上游 bundui 的真实组件 property-list-02 在本地沙箱中的实际渲染。
description.en: Showcase available properties with Tailwind CSS property list sections. These layouts feature images, titles, prices, and brief details to help users browse options easily. Perfect for real estate websites and marketplaces aiming for modern, organized, and visually appealing property displays. Rendered from the original source at commit c07468613dfe7db776f1749a0921a1e5e7bd33d5.
